Is there a process used regularly to keep the inventory up to date?
Is there an inventory of all processing activities where data is being obtained?
Are details of processing (scope, purpose, consent) documented for each activity?

column4: Does the organization have a data governance program?

Are there data privacy and protection policies?
Is there technology to monitor and report policy violations?
Do policies enforce accountability within the organization?

column1: M.2: Provide detailed notice of processing activities to data subjects

column4: Does the organization provide privacy notices to data subjects?
Are the privacy notices written in clear and plain language?
Are notices governed by a formal policy/process for timely sharing?
Do notices include contact details and purposes for data use?
Are notices shared at first contact when informing subjects of objections?
Are notices generated and shared by automated means?
Are notices shared at all points where personal data is collected?
Are notices shared when data is obtained from third-party sources?
Are notices shared before using data for new purposes?
Can the organization discontinue processing some forms of data on request?
Can the organization stop all processing (especially marketing) on request?
Is justification provided to the subject if a request is rejected?
Does the organization maintain evidence of discontinued data use?
Is there a process to respond to stop-processing requests promptly?
Are stop-processing activities performed automatically?

column1: M.4: Collect unambiguous, granular consent from data subjects

column4: Can the organization obtain consent from data subjects?
Is consent obtained prior to processing?
Is consent obtained promptly for all required activities?
Does the organization automatically obtain all necessary consent?

column1: M.5: Facilitate communication mechanism between data subject and organization

column4: Is there a published way for subjects to communicate on privacy?
Is there an online portal for erasure/objection requests (DSAR)?
Are there backend tools to track requests to resolution?
Can the organization validate the identity of requestors?
Is personnel trained to respond to privacy requests?
Can the organization notify recipients of data about erasure/restrictions?
Can subjects/regulators view the status of their requests?
Are response times (e.g., 30 days) defined for requestors?
Can the organization automatically respond to inquiries?

column1: M.6: Rectify inaccurate or incomplete personal data

column4: Can the organization correct/complete data when requested?
Can the organization correct ALL data subject instances?
Is evidence of corrections recorded and shareable?
Are corrections performed consistently and promptly?
Are some corrections performed automatically?
Are all corrections performed automatically?

column1: M.7: Erase personal data regarding a data subject (Right to be Forgotten)

column4: Is there a mechanism to locate and erase data on request?
Is personnel trained on how to locate and erase data?
Can personnel determine when erasure should be fulfilled vs. denied?
Is there a process to erase data completely and accurately?
Is there a record that an erasure request was fulfilled?
Can the organization contact other controllers to fulfill erasure?
Is there technology to erase data across multiple data stores?
Can erasure be performed automatically?

column1: M.8: Provide data subject with their personal data (Data Portability)

column4: Can subjects get a copy of their data in electronic format?
Is data provided in a common, machine-readable format (.xls/.xml)?
Is data provided automatically to the subject?
Can data be sent directly to another controller?

column1: M.9: Restrict the processing of personal data

column4: Is there a policy to restrict processing when required?
Can the organization suspend/restrict processing on request?
Are there procedures to notify processors to restrict processing?
Are recipients notified automatically of restrictions?
Is there a process to notify subjects if a restriction is lifted?
Are subjects notified automatically when processing resumes?
Is a record maintained of restricted processing instances?
Is a record maintained of why restrictions were resumed?

Is privacy integrated into all relevant policies and processes?
Is a privacy culture embedded through ongoing training?
Is privacy integrated into the SDLC?

Are integrity measures (hashing, backups) in place?

Are breach response procedures regularly updated?
Are metrics maintained for breach detection/remediation?
